findings.evidence: Line 82 uses `f (…repr z) x Q2 ζ` with `x Q2 ζ` passed through untouched; line 112 instantiates with a constant-in-the-last-three-arguments function. Roadmap `Suggested.lean:226` types the vector slot as a bare `Transverse` argument.
findings.fix: Define `azimuthalAverage (f : TransversePlane → ℝ) (kT : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.circleAverage (fun z => f (Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr z)) 0 kT` and drop `x Q2 ζ` from all four lemmas; in `azimuthalTmd` apply it to `fun v => Φ v i x Q2 ζ`.
findings.issue: `azimuthalAverage` carries three inert parameters: `f : TransversePlane → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ` is only ever used as `f · x Q2 ζ`, so the operator is specialized to the TMD argument shape for no gain. The same three dummies propagate to `azimuthalAverage_eq_integral` (86), `azimuthalAverage_eq_zero_of_odd` (95), `azimuthalAverage_areaForm_eq_zero` (109) and `azimuthalAverage_nonneg` (119), and force the padding `fun w _ _ _ => o.areaForm w v` plus three junk reals at line 112. It also cannot be applied to the roadmap's `area bT kT`-style weights, which are plain `Transverse → ℝ`.

findings.evidence: Line 124 discharges the goal with `Real.circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg`, whose own hypothesis is `(h₂f : ∀ x ∈ Metric.sphere c |R|, 0 ≤ f x)` (mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/CircleAverage.lean:304-306) — upstream already states this at the sphere-restricted level. The sibling lemma at line 97 fixes `x Q2 ζ`, so the global quantification at 121 is not even internally consistent.
findings.fix: Weaken to `(hf : ∀ v, ‖v‖ = |kT| → 0 ≤ f v x Q2 ζ)` (or at minimum `∀ v, 0 ≤ f v x Q2 ζ`), and correspondingly restrict `hf` in `azimuthalAverage_eq_zero_of_odd` to `‖w‖ = |kT|`.
findings.issue: `azimuthalAverage_nonneg` assumes `hf : ∀ v x Q2 ζ, 0 ≤ f v x Q2 ζ` although the conclusion is at one fixed `(x, Q2, ζ)` and only values on the circle `‖v‖ = |kT|` enter. Same over-quantification in `azimuthalAverage_eq_zero_of_odd` (line 97), which demands oddness at every `w` rather than on that circle.

findings.evidence: `IsTmdDensity.nonneg : ∀ i x kT Q2 ζ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ kT → 0 ≤ f i x kT Q2 ζ` (TMD/Basic.lean:62); the roadmap's target signature also restricts the hypothesis this way: `(_ : ∀ i x kT Q2 ζ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ f i x kT Q2 ζ)` (roadmap Suggested.lean:234).
findings.fix: Weaken to `hΦ : ∀ v i x Q2 ζ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ Φ v i x Q2 ζ` and pass the bound `hx0 hx1` through to the weakened `azimuthalAverage_nonneg`.
findings.issue: `azimuthalTmd_isTmdDensity` assumes `hΦ : ∀ v i x Q2 ζ, 0 ≤ Φ v i x Q2 ζ` everywhere, but `IsTmdDensity.nonneg` only claims nonnegativity for `0 ≤ x`, `x ≤ 1`, `0 ≤ kT`; the proof at line 149 binds those three hypotheses as `_ _ hkT` and throws two of them away.

findings.evidence: Roadmap Suggested.lean:15 and :51 — orbital weight `area bT kT`, `area u v = u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0`; Mathlib has `Orientation.areaForm : E →ₗ[ℝ] E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ` (TwoDim.lean:91) and `areaForm_swap` (TwoDim.lean:109).
findings.fix: State the corollary for a linear functional, `azimuthalAverage (fun w => L w) … = 0` for `L : TransversePlane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ` (linear ⇒ odd, so the existing proof applies), and derive both `o.areaForm · v` and `o.areaForm v ·` from it; or add the companion second-slot lemma via `Orientation.areaForm_swap`.
findings.issue: `azimuthalAverage_areaForm_eq_zero` covers only `w ↦ ω(w, v)`; the roadmap's orbital weight is `area bT kT`, i.e. the averaged variable in the second slot, which this corollary does not give. Picking one slot of an antisymmetric form is arbitrary under-generalization.

findings.evidence: grep for `radialVector` across `code/` returns hits only at Average.lean:62,66,67,70,71,72,89 — the `_of_nonneg` variant is never applied.
findings.fix: Delete it; callers can use `radialVector_norm` with `abs_of_nonneg`.
findings.issue: `radialVector_norm_of_nonneg` is a one-step specialization of `radialVector_norm` by `abs_of_nonneg` with no use anywhere in the repository and no roadmap need.

summary: The averaging operator is hard-wired to the TMD parameter shape (three inert `x Q2 ζ` arguments) instead of acting on a plain function `TransversePlane → ℝ`, and two nonnegativity hypotheses are quantified far more broadly than the conclusions need. The area-form corollary also covers only one slot of `ω`, not the slot the roadmap's orbital weight uses.
